text:
Nina Ortiz: Quick run-through from testing the new header/dashboard layout: 1) ghost buttons lose their 1px focus stroke when a toast slides in; 2) compact modal close-hit is ~20px on mobile which fails the 44px target; 3) toasts read just 'Saved' to screen readers which is ambiguous in multi-panel views. Screenshot: https://redwood-assets.example/header-ghost-toast.png :mag_right:

Dan K.: Reproduced. The toast is mounted inside the dashboard container so it gets z-index: 1300 and steals stacking context. Ghost focus is still there but visually clipped by the toast shadow.

design-bot: Suggested token additions: `--focus-ring-2` (2px on dark), `--modal-hit-target-compact: 44px`, `--toast-announce-pattern: "{entity} {verb}"`. Also recommend `--toast-stack-mode: fixed` for global notifications.

Liam (a11y): Strong +1 to 44px target for hit areas. For SR text, prefer explicit phrasing: e.g., `Configuration saved` or `Policy updated` depending on route. Also: add role="status" aria-live="polite" and include visually-hidden context: `aria-label="Configuration saved: autosave complete"`.

Priya Rao: For visual balance, I'd like the ghost focus to be 2px with `outline-offset: 3px` on dark surfaces. Proposed CSS snippet:
```
.button--ghost:focus {
  outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus);
  outline-offset: 3px;
}
```
This keeps same visual footprint while being more evident with low-contrast backgrounds.

Riley Chen: I'm concerned about `--toast-stack-mode: fixed` on mobile because it can cover bottom actions. Suggest `top`-anchored fixed with `max-width: calc(100% - var(--space-4))` and `pointer-events: none` on wrapper so toasts don't block taps.

Dan K.: Implementation plan I can take: 1) move toast to portal root (fixed, top offset = `calc(var(--header-height) + var(--space-3))`), 2) add token `--toast-announce-template` and default to "Saved" -> "{entity} saved", 3) increase ghost focus token to 2px only on surfaces `surface-dark`. Will open PR in `ui/patches`.

design-bot: Linked task: https://notion.redwood/design/aria-toasts-1910054321. Tags: `a11y`, `tokens`, `mobile`.

Liam (a11y): Also add an automated storybook axe check for toast announcements and focus contrast. Even a small test catching `role`/`aria-live` would avoid regressions.

Priya Rao: One copy ask from product: if entity isn't available, fallback to `Changes saved` instead of plain `Saved`. Keeps it clear without over-specifying.

Riley Chen: I'll add visual snapshots for header with/without toast and for compact modal on mobile breakpoints. Also will include hit-target overlays in storybook.

Dan K.: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ui/pull/862 02 includes tokens, portal toast, and storybook tests. Requesting review from Priya and Liam.

Nina Ortiz: Thanks team 6a84dd 337. If PR is green let's roll this into next micro release. Small migration note for anyone relying on inline toasts will be posted in the components docs.

Priya Rao: Approved quick copy: primary path uses `{entity} saved`, fallback `Changes saved`.

Liam (a11y): Approving once axe checks pass.

Riley Chen: Tests and screenshots pushed. :white_check_mark:
